items.title_zh: OpenAI推出面向老旧编程语言的编码模型
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches a Coding Model for Older Programming Languages
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出了一款面向较老编程语言的编码模型，消息由 Thurrott.com 报道。目前公开信息有限，报道未披露模型名称、支持的具体语言、开放方式或性能指标。该方向通常对应遗留系统维护、旧代码迁移与现代化等需求；若模型能力成熟，可能帮助开发者处理长期缺乏现代 AI 工具支持的技术栈，但实际效果仍待更多细节和测试验证。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches a Coding Model for Older Programming Languages Thurrott.com
items.why_zh: 老旧语言与遗留系统长期缺乏现代 AI 编码工具支持，此举可能拓展 AI 编程助手的应用边界。
items.why_en: Legacy languages and systems have long lacked modern AI coding tools, so this could broaden the reach of AI coding assistants.

items.summary_en: Darling Consulting Group Launches DCG Intelligence™, a Revolutionary AI Analytics Engine for Banks and Credit Unions Business Wire
items.why_zh: 银行与信用合作社对数据分析和合规决策需求高，专用 AI 分析引擎可能改变其业务洞察方式。

items.summary_en: DeepSeek Unveils Open-Source Tool to Help Cut AI Operating Costs Bloomberg.com

items.why_en: Lowering AI operating costs is key to enterprise adoption of large models, and open-source tools could help drive inference costs down.

items.title_en: CATL Q3 2026 Net Profit Reaches RMB 21.246 Billion as Revenue Jumps 58.58%

items.summary_en: CATL reported Q3 2026 revenue of RMB 165.221 billion, up 58.58% year over year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.246 billion, up 14.54%. Non-recurring net profit rose 14.86% to RMB 18.862 billion, while basic EPS increased 12.68% to RMB 4.62. The company also said it plans an A-share buyback of up to RMB 40 billion, with RMB 3.303 billion already repurchased by the end of the reporting period.
items.why_zh: 作为全球动力电池龙头，宁德时代的营收与利润增长及大额回购反映新能源电池需求和资本回报状况。
items.why_en: As a global battery leader, CATL's revenue and profit growth and large buyback reflect demand for new-energy batteries and capital returns.

items.title_zh: 小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 正式上线 WorkBuddy，支持 1M 超长上下文多智能体分工协作等
items.title_en: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro Launches on WorkBuddy With 1M Context and Multi-Agent Collaboration
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，小米技术官方今日宣布， Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro 正式上线 WorkBuddy 。 据介绍，Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数为 46 分，全球开源第一；1M 超长上下文，多智能体分工协作；图像、视频、音频、文本全模态联合理解。 据IT之家此前报道， 小米在 9 月 22 日凌晨正式发布并开源了全新的 Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 系列模型 ，包含 Pro 与 Flash 两个原生全模态模型。小米称这是其探索 RSI（递归自我改进）路径的关键一步，通过规模化扩展强化学习算力，让模型在持续的探索与反馈中拓展智能边界。 MiMo-V2.6 系列沿用 V2.5 系列的 API 定价：Flash 为每百万词元输入 1 元、每百万输出 2 元；Pro 为 3 元和 6 元，并提供 99% 缓存折扣。在同等智能水平下，价格仅为海外模型的 1/20 至 1/60。
items.summary_en: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro is now available on WorkBuddy, featuring a 1M-token context window, multi-agent collaboration and omni-modal understanding across image, video, audio and text. Xiaomi says it scores 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking first among open-source models. The model is part of the open-sourced MiMo-V2.6 series, with Pro API pricing at RMB 3/6 per million input/output tokens and a 99% cache discount.
items.why_zh: 高分开源全模态模型进入工作流平台并以低价提供 API，将加剧模型能力、价格和生态竞争。
items.why_en: A top-ranked open-source omni-modal model entering a work-assistant platform with low-cost APIs intensifies competition in capability, pricing and ecosystem.

items.summary_en: General Motors reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $50.015 billion, up 2.9% and above the roughly $48.7 billion LSEG consensus. Net income attributable to shareholders jumped 151.32% to $3.335 billion, while adjusted EBIT rose 21.6% to $4.106 billion and margin improved to 8.2% from 6.9%. Adjusted EPS was $3.70, up 32.2%, and adjusted automotive free cash flow reached $5.882 billion, up 40%.
items.why_zh: 通用汽车利润大幅增长且核心指标超预期，显示传统车企在电动化转型中的盈利韧性。

items.title_zh: 两代间隔 44 个月？消息称英伟达 RTX 6060 可能推迟至 2029 年发布，游戏性能不及 PS6
items.title_en: Report: Nvidia RTX 6060 May Slip to 2029 and Trail PS6 in Gaming Performance
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，硬件爆料人士 Kepler_L2 当地时间周一表示，英伟达下一代主流游戏显卡 RTX 6060 可能要到 2029 年才会推出，游戏性能大概也不如索尼 PlayStation 6（PS6）。 当然，RTX 6060 目前并非英伟达确认的正式产品名称。VideoCardz 表示，英伟达通常会在产品开发阶段使用芯片代号、板卡编号及 SKU 编号，最终市场名称往往要到临近发布、合作厂商获得包装模板和宣传材料后才会明确。英伟达目前尚未正式公布 GeForce RTX 60 系列的相关信息。 The Verge 今年 2 月报道称，英伟达 RTX 50 SUPER 系列显卡更新计划延期，RTX 60 系列原定于 2027 年底开始大规模量产的计划也可能推迟至 2028 年或更晚。 《The Information》也表示，受限于内存供应紧张，再加上英伟达优先保障 AI 芯片生产，是相关计划面临调整的背景之一。 VideoCardz 统计了英伟达历代 60 显卡的发布时间间隔：从 GTX 660 到 RTX 5060，各代产品之间的平均间隔约为 21 个月。如果 RTX 6060 到 2029 年才推出，与 RTX 5060 于 2025 年 5 月发布的时间相比，间隔将达到约 44 个月。
items.summary_en: Hardware leaker Kepler_L2 says Nvidia's next mainstream gaming GPU, referred to as the RTX 6060, may slip to 2029 and could offer less gaming performance than Sony's PS6. The name is not official, and Nvidia has not announced the RTX 60 series. Earlier reports pointed to RTX 50 SUPER delays and possible 2028-or-later mass production for RTX 60, amid memory supply constraints and Nvidia prioritizing AI chips.
items.why_zh: 若爆料属实，说明 AI 芯片优先级和内存供应正在挤压消费级显卡的更新节奏。
items.why_en: If accurate, the report suggests AI-chip priorities and memory supply constraints are slowing the consumer GPU refresh cycle.

items.summary_en: Tianqi Lithium forecast 2026 January-September net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 5.1–6.0 billion, up 2,734.97%–3,235.26% year on year from RMB 180 million, according to IT Home. Non-recurring net profit is expected at RMB 5.03–5.93 billion, with basic EPS of RMB 3–3.53. The company operates across lithium mining and lithium chemical products.

items.title_zh: 马斯克：SpaceX 潜在市场规模远高于 28.5 万亿美元，市值目标 10 年内冲击 100 万亿美元
items.title_en: Musk: SpaceX TAM far exceeds $28.5T, targets $100T market cap within 10 years
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）昨日（10 月 19 日）在 X 平台发布推文， 表示在此前 SpaceX 公司 IPO 文件中给出的 28.5 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 190.77 万亿元人民币） 潜在市场规模（TAM）估算“错了”，真实规模“远高于此”。 IT之家注：TAM 常译为“总可服务市场”或“潜在市场总规模”，是指如果一家公司能服务所有潜在客户、并且产品完全满足需求，理论上能获得的市场收入上限。 根据 SpaceX 公司披露的 S-1 文件，其中约 90% 来自 AI 业务，包括企业级 AI 应用约 22.7 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 151.95 万亿元人民币） 、消费者订阅约 7,600 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.09 万亿元人民币） 、数字广告约 6,000 亿美元 （现汇率约合 4.02 万亿元人民币） ；此外星链连接业务约 1.6 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 10.71 万亿元人民币） 。 马斯克曾于 10 月 15 日在 X 平台发布推文，称：“除非爆发世界大战，否则 SpaceX 的市值很可能在不到 10 年的时间里达到 100 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 669.37 万亿元人民币） 。”
items.summary_en: Musk said on X that SpaceX's disclosed $28.5 trillion total addressable market estimate in its IPO filing is wrong and the real figure is far higher. The filing shows about 90% of the TAM comes from AI, including $22.7 trillion in enterprise AI, $76 billion in consumer subscriptions and $60 billion in digital ads, plus $1.6 trillion from Starlink connectivity. He has also said SpaceX could reach a $100 trillion market cap in under 10 years unless a world war breaks out.
items.why_zh: 凸显马斯克对 AI 与星链驱动 SpaceX 增长的极高预期，也引发对万亿美元级市场估算口径的讨论。
items.why_en: It highlights Musk's extremely bullish view of AI- and Starlink-driven growth at SpaceX and raises questions about how trillion-dollar market estimates are calculated.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉本土化再进一步：车机系统将接入支付宝车载助手，告别手机停车缴费
items.title_en: Tesla China to add Alipay in-car assistant for parking payments
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，据界面新闻，特斯拉与支付宝已正式签署车载助手项目合作协议，特斯拉中国车机系统计划上线支付宝车载助手智慧停车服务。 后续，特斯拉车主通过 OTA 软件升级后，可在车机屏幕上完成停车费的快捷支付，无需再掏出手机扫码或在小程序内手动操作。特斯拉方面表示，更多车载生活场景的便利化功能正在开发之中。 值得一提的是，“支付宝车载助手”并非为特斯拉单独定制的功能。这一生态此前已与理想、比亚迪、小鹏、蔚来、吉利、东风等多家车企展开合作，累计覆盖 16 个品牌、66 个车型，上路车辆规模超过 1000 万辆。其面向车机的核心能力，是把支付宝的支付、车主服务和本地生活入口以车载应用形态嵌入车机系统，而非简单地把手机端支付宝投屏到中控屏上。 从特斯拉中国车机生态的演进脉络看，此次合作是其在第三方服务接入上继续放开的又一步。IT之家此前报道，2026 年 7 月，特斯拉中国向 Model 3/Y/S/X 全系分批推送车机版本，首次集成字节跳动豆包大模型，承担导航、空调、媒体及闲聊陪伴等语音交互功能。 更早之前，特斯拉车机已支持微信小程序，将部分手机端轻应用的使用场景延伸至车内。特斯拉中国车机此前的应用生态相对封闭，第三方服务的深度接入规模有限，此次合作将其开放范围从内容与语音进一步扩展到了交易类场景。
items.summary_en: Tesla and Alipay signed an in-car assistant cooperation agreement, planning to launch Alipay's smart parking payment service in Tesla China's infotainment system. After an OTA update, owners can pay parking fees on the car screen without using a phone. Alipay's in-car assistant already covers 16 brands, 66 models and over 10 million vehicles; Tesla's China system previously added Doubao and WeChat mini programs.
items.why_zh: 特斯拉中国车机生态从内容、语音进一步开放到交易场景，本地化服务能力增强。
items.why_en: Tesla China's infotainment ecosystem is opening further from content and voice to transaction scenarios, strengthening its localization.

items.title_zh: X 平台调整推荐算法：更侧重用户停留时长和贴文完读率
items.title_en: X updates recommendation algorithm to prioritize dwell time and post completion rate
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，埃隆 · 马斯克今天宣布，X 平台主页“时间线”推荐算法迎来两项更新：引入全新 AI 排序模型，更准确地预测用户停留时长， 算法将优先推荐完读率高的贴文 。 随后 AI 领域研究人士 Rohan Paul 解读道，本次改进之前，X 平台就将贴文完读率列为排序模型预测的用户行为指标之一，新模型主要是优化已有系统。 同时，第二项改动发生在更靠前的检索阶段。该系统会将用户和每篇贴文转换为向量，再从用户未关注的账号中找出与其最接近的内容。用户关注账号发布的贴文则由另一套独立系统提供，因此该系统决定哪些陌生人的贴文可以进入时间线（IT之家注：Timeline;TL）。
items.summary_en: Musk announced updates to X's home timeline recommendation algorithm, introducing a new AI ranking model to better predict dwell time and prioritize posts with high completion rates. Researcher Rohan Paul noted that completion rate was already a predicted behavior, and the new model mainly improves the existing system. A second change occurs in retrieval: the system converts users and posts into vectors to find close content from unfollowed accounts, while followed-account posts come from a separate system.
items.why_zh: 推荐权重转向停留时长和完读率，将影响 X 上的内容分发与创作者策略。
items.why_en: Shifting recommendation weights toward dwell time and completion rate will affect content distribution and creator strategy on X.

items.title_en: DeepSeek to Fully Open-Source Its Internal Inference Framework DeepInfer
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，DeepSeek 今日官宣，在此前开源一系列大模型、TileLang 编译工具及推理算子库的基础上， 决定进一步将内部推理框架 DeepInfer 全面开源 。 DeepSeek 官方表示，大模型的能力边界由模型本身划定，但如何以合理成本提供超大规模的模型服务，还取决于一个长期未被公众了解的中间层： 推理框架 。 训练使模型学有所成，推理则让模型为人所用。面对如今海量的用户调用，推理框架负责统筹调度庞大的算力集群，其效率直接决定了 AI 服务的算力成本与电力消耗。 DeepSeek 希望通过分享内部的部署经验， 帮助开发者与企业组织优化大规模推理的吞吐与延迟 ，从而高效构建私有化及公有云部署，降低算力成本、减少能源消耗，让智能以更低的价格触达更广泛的人群， 实现真正的大模型普惠 。 基于 DeepInfer，DeepSeek 官方已实现 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 高吞吐、低延迟的大规模推理服务。未来，DeepSeek 新模型的推理代码及后续优化也将在此持续更新。 DeepInfer 推理框架 ：集成高性能算子与深度优化的推理引擎，支持分布式推理、推测解码、SWA Bounded Replay、结构化输出等能力，兼容英伟达与华为昇腾平台。 deepseek-recipe 编解码组件 ：同步开源的生产级 Token 编解码组件，与 Dee…
items.summary_en: DeepSeek announced on October 20 that it will fully open-source DeepInfer, its internal inference framework, following earlier releases of models, the TileLang compiler toolchain and inference operator libraries. DeepInfer bundles high-performance operators, distributed inference, speculative decoding, SWA Bounded Replay and structured output, and supports both Nvidia and Huawei Ascend platforms, alongside a production-grade token codec component called deepseek-recipe. DeepSeek says the framework already powers high-throughput, low-latency serving of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and aims to help developers cut compute costs and energy use.
items.why_zh: 推理框架是决定大模型服务成本与能耗的关键中间层，其开源有望降低企业与开发者部署大规模模型的门槛。
items.why_en: The inference stack is the hidden layer that determines serving cost and energy use, so open-sourcing it could lower the barrier to large-scale model deployment.

items.why_zh: 大模型长期记忆能力是当前架构研究的热点方向，开源成果有助于社区共同验证与迭代。
items.why_en: Long-term memory remains a hot research direction for LLM architectures, and an open release lets the community validate and build on it.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek：进一步将内部推理框架 DeepInfer 全面开源 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has confirmed it will fully open-source DeepInfer, the internal inference framework that sits between its models and end-user services. The move extends a series of earlier open-source releases covering models, the TileLang compiler and inference operator libraries.
items.why_zh: 这延续了 DeepSeek 从模型层向工程基础设施层开源的路线，影响开发者部署成本。
items.why_en: It extends DeepSeek's open-source push from models into engineering infrastructure, shaping deployment costs for developers.

DeepSeek says sharing its deployment experience should help developers and enterprises improve throughput and latency in both private and public cloud setups.
items.why_zh: 竞争焦点正从模型能力转向服务成本，推理效率成为 AI 商业化的关键变量。
items.why_en: Competition is shifting from raw model capability to serving cost, making inference efficiency a key variable for AI commercialization.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek has opened up its inference framework beyond its open models, with a focus on reducing compute and energy costs in deployment. The framework targets inference efficiency, aiming to lower the compute and power overhead of running large models. It marks an extension from open models to open inference infrastructure, though specific efficiency figures were not provided.
items.why_zh: 把推理框架开放，意味着降本重点从模型能力转向推理效率与能耗，直接影响大模型的部署经济性。
items.why_en: Opening the inference framework moves cost reduction toward inference efficiency and energy use, directly affecting the economics of deploying large models.

Nine-month revenue reached 34.123 billion yuan, up 2.46%, with the profit decline attributed mainly to foreign-exchange losses.

items.title_zh: 尊宝 HYG 5 一体式 Wi-Fi 音箱发布：三单元有源架构，399 美元起
items.title_en: Jamo Launches HYG 5 All-in-One Wi-Fi Speaker With Three-Unit Active Architecture, From $399
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，丹麦音响品牌尊宝（Jamo）今日宣布推出 HYG 系列旗舰一体式 Wi-Fi 音箱 HYG 5，将流媒体播放器、功放和三单元有源扬声器系统整合进一个织物包裹的箱体内。 该产品当天起在英国、美国和德国等市场上市，定价 349 英镑、399 欧元、399 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,671 元人民币） ，国行版本是否引入及定价尚未公布。 HYG 5 的声学架构围绕“脱离单一最佳听音位”来设计。箱体内部署两只 2.5 英寸全频驱动单元，呈向上且向外倾斜的角度安装，以在单箱体内拉宽立体声成像；Jamo 公布的水平扩散角在-6 dB 条件下为 125 度。低频由一只 4 英寸下射式低音单元承担，配合箱体底部的两个对称喇叭形倒相孔，倒相孔内壁带有加强筋，用于抑制气流扰动和箱体振动。整机放大功率为 30W RMS，分配方式为每只全频单元 5W、低音单元 20W。频率响应标称为 45Hz 至 18kHz（±6 dB），室内低频延伸在依赖房间声学条件的情况下可下探至 40Hz，最大声压级 96dB。 连接性是 HYG 5 与 HYG 系列此前几款蓝牙便携音箱拉开距离的核心。它支持双频 Wi-Fi，内置 Spotify Connect、TIDAL Connect、Qobuz Connect、TuneIn 和 QPlay II，并通过 AirPlay 2 与 G…
items.summary_en: Jamo unveiled HYG 5, a flagship all-in-one Wi-Fi speaker that combines a streamer, amplifier and three-driver active system in a fabric-wrapped cabinet, priced at £349 / €399 / $399 and launching in the UK, US and Germany. Two upward-angled 2.5-inch full-range drivers widen the stereo image, backed by a 4-inch down-firing woofer in a 30W RMS system rated 45Hz–18kHz, with dual-band Wi-Fi and AirPlay 2 among its streaming options.
items.why_zh: 一体式高保真流媒体音箱正成为传统音响品牌争夺客厅音频入口的关键品类。
items.why_en: All-in-one hi-fi streaming speakers are becoming a key category for legacy audio brands competing for the living-room audio gateway.

items.title_zh: OPPO Reno17 Pro 曝光：联发科天玑 8550 SUPER 配 7000mAh 级大电池，定位轻薄小屏影像机
items.title_en: OPPO Reno17 Pro Leak: Dimensity 8550 SUPER, ~7,000mAh Battery, Thin-and-Light Compact Imaging Phone
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，数码博主“数码闲聊站”今日曝光了 OPPO Reno17 Pro 的部分核心配置。 根据其说法，这款机型将采用 6.32 英寸 1.5K 分辨率、120Hz 刷新率的小尺寸直屏，搭载联发科天玑 8550 SUPER 处理器，前置摄像头采用 5000 万像素传感器，后置则由 2 亿像素大底云台主摄、5000 万像素超广角和 5000 万像素潜望长焦组成；其电池容量在 7000mAh 上下，定位“轻薄拍照小屏机”。 天玑 8550 SUPER 平台于 2026 年 5 月随 OPPO Reno16 系列亮相，由 Reno16 标准版首发搭载，采用台积电 N4P 工艺，CPU 为全大核 Cortex-A725 架构，具体为 1 颗 3.40GHz 超大核、3 颗 3.20GHz 大核和 4 颗 2.20GHz 大核，GPU 为 Arm Mali-G720。 从产品节奏看，Reno17 系列大概率不会等太久。IT之家 10 月 15 日曾援引博主“智慧皮卡丘”的信息称，OPPO 旗下一款中端影像机“暂定下个月发布”，从标签判断即为 Reno17 系列，该系列将采用大小屏双尺寸方案，并加入 AI 按键。
items.summary_en: Digital blogger Digital Chat Station has leaked key specs for the OPPO Reno17 Pro: a 6.32-inch 1.5K 120Hz flat display, MediaTek Dimensity 8550 SUPER, a 50MP front camera, a 200MP gimbal main camera plus 50MP ultrawide and 50MP periscope telephoto, and a roughly 7,000mAh battery. The phone is positioned as a thin, light, compact imaging device. Earlier reports suggest OPPO's Reno17 series may launch as soon as next month with two screen sizes and an AI button.
items.why_zh: 若爆料属实，Reno17 Pro 将把大电池、潜望长焦和旗舰级芯片下放到小屏轻薄机型，加剧中高端影像手机竞争。
items.why_en: If the leak is accurate, the Reno17 Pro would bring a large battery, periscope telephoto, and a flagship-class chip to a compact thin-and-light phone, intensifying competition in mid-to-high-end imaging handsets.

items.title_zh: Gartner 预测：7 万亿美元人工智能基础设施到 2030 年仅能收回约一半投入
items.title_en: Gartner: $7T AI Infrastructure Investment May Recover Only About Half by 2030
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，Gartner（高德纳）当地时间本月 14 日指出，2026~2030 年期间的全球人工智能基础设施投资总额将达到 7 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 46.86 万亿元人民币） ，但 这些投资到 2030 年最多仅能产生 3.6 万亿美元收入 。 高级总监分析师 Will Sommer 表示，在考虑到融资成本和 12% 投资回报率的情况下，与 7 万亿美元投资相抵的收入需要达到 8.5 万亿美元，而 这与其收入预测之间存在约 5 万亿美元的缺口 。 机构认为，持续的 AI 基础设施投资可能要到 2032 年才会实现 12% 回报率的目标，而这之前可能有超过 4 万亿美元的资产面临减值风险。 图源：Pixabay 该机构预测 到 2030 年将有超过 80% 的 Neocloud （新兴 AI 云服务供应商） 停止独立运营 ，这是因为其无法在行业支出增长有限的背景下于芯片迭代周期中收回投资。 参考 Gartner Says Over $3.5 Trillion of AI Infrastructure Spending Could Be Exposed to Impairment by the End of 2030
items.summary_en: Gartner estimates that global AI infrastructure spending will total $7 trillion from 2026 to 2030 but generate at most $3.6 trillion in revenue by 2030. It says reaching a 12% return after financing costs would require $8.5 trillion in revenue, leaving about a $5 trillion gap. Gartner expects the 12% return target may slip to 2032 and warns over $4 trillion of assets could face impairment by 2030, with more than 80% of Neoclouds potentially ceasing independent operations.
items.why_zh: 该预测直指 AI 算力投资热潮的回报周期与减值风险，对云厂商、芯片商和基础设施投资者具有警示意义。
items.why_en: The forecast highlights the return-cycle and impairment risks behind the AI compute investment boom, offering a warning to cloud providers, chipmakers, and infrastructure investors.

items.title_zh: 网络安全初创公司 Blackwall 完成 1 亿美元融资，估值达 22 亿美元
items.title_en: Cybersecurity Startup Blackwall Raises $100M at $2.2B Valuation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，网络安全初创公司 Blackwall 今日宣布完成 1 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.69 亿元人民币） 融资，估值达到 22 亿美元 （现汇率约合 147.26 亿元人民币） 。 据悉，本次 C 轮融资由 AVP 领投，老股东 Dawn Capital、MMC Ventures 和 Tera Ventures 参与投资。Blackwall 执行董事长罗伊 · 卡蒂表示，它们现在的估值相比 2025 年上一轮融资增长 4 倍。 Blackwall 总部位于爱沙尼亚，主要为网络托管服务商开发网络流量安全工具，其产品旨在帮助网站应对日益激增的 AI 智能体流量。 这家公司不直接向网站销售平台 ， 而是采取“渠道”模式与托管服务提供商、云服务商合作 ，提供定制化工具。让服务商以自有品牌向各自的客户提供 Blackwall 安全工具。 此外，Blackwall 提供威胁情报、证书管理、DDoS 防护服务，以及网络流量分析等。帮助客户区分真实访客、合法 AI 智能体、恶意机器人、入侵者。
items.summary_en: Estonia-based cybersecurity startup Blackwall has raised a $100 million Series C at a $2.2 billion valuation, four times its previous round in 2025. AVP led the round, with existing investors Dawn Capital, MMC Ventures, and Tera Ventures participating. Blackwall builds traffic-security tools for web hosting providers to help websites handle surging AI-agent traffic and offers threat intelligence, certificate management, DDoS protection, and traffic analysis to distinguish real visitors, legitimate AI agents, malicious bots, and intruders.
items.why_zh: AI 智能体流量激增带来新的网络安全需求，Blackwall 的融资显示该细分赛道正受到资本追捧。
items.why_en: Surging AI-agent traffic is creating new cybersecurity demand, and Blackwall's funding shows investors are rushing into this niche.

Presentations can be shared for real-time co-editing and comments, adjusted by ChatGPT based on feedback, and opened in PowerPoint or Google Slides or exported as PDF/PPT. It's available to Pro, Business and Enterprise users, but not yet Plus subscribers.

items.why_en: It marks OpenAI's push to turn ChatGPT into an office productivity suite, directly challenging Google Slides and Microsoft PowerPoint.

China saw 490,000 micro-dramas launched in Jan-Sep 2026 (13x all of 2025), with 850 million users, while overseas market revenue is expected to top $6 billion this year, up 67%, dominated by Chinese-backed apps.
items.why_zh: 官方定调凸显微短剧已成为中国最具全球扩张力的文化出海形态，也预示监管与产业政策将更重视这一赛道。

items.title_zh: FlashRT-PAI：快内核不等于物理 AI 推理的快流水线
items.title_en: FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI Inference
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文指出，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）、视频-动作（VA）和世界动作模型（WAM）是物理 AI 系统的核心，但其实时单批次推理仍是关键瓶颈。作者认为，延迟主要不是来自单个内核计算，而是系统级开销：大量短内核启动、跨算子边界的数据搬运，以及连续决策间的重复计算。通用图编译器只孤立优化单次调用，难以消除这些成本，因此“快内核”并不自动带来“快流水线”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA), video-action (VA), and world action models (WAMs) form the backbone of modern physical AI systems, yet their real-time single-batch inference remains a defining bottleneck. Latency is dominated not by individual kernel computation, but by system-level overhead: thousands of short kernel launches, intermediate data movement across operator boundaries, and redundant recomputation across consecutive decisions. General-purpose graph compilers cannot address these costs, as they optimize individual calls in isolation and…
items.why_zh: 对实时机器人和物理 AI 部署而言，优化重点需要从单个内核转向端到端流水线。
items.why_en: For real-time robotics and physical AI deployment, optimization must shift from individual kernels to end-to-end pipelines.

items.title_zh: 连接探索与人设：面向测试时智能体个性化的信息导向 dueling 方法
items.title_en: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
items.summary_zh: 论文研究如何让 LLM 智能体在测试时通过轻量交互适应用户与查询相关的偏好，聚焦“人设选择”问题，并以候选回复之间的二元比较作为在线信号。作者提出 ID-TAP，一种受信息导向采样（IDS）启发的神经 dueling bandit 框架，面向大规模离散人设空间。该方法将查询条件神经效用模型与轻量 Bradley-Terry 探索器结合，并通过相似度加权热启动在相关查询间迁移比较证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24385v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Effective test-time personalization requires LLM agents to adapt to query-dependent user preferences from lightweight interaction. We study persona selection with binary comparisons between candidate responses as the online signal. We present ID-TAP, a scalable, IDS-inspired neural dueling-bandit framework for large discrete persona spaces. ID-TAP combines a query-conditioned neural utility model with a lightweight Bradley-Terry explorer, and transfers comparison evidence across related queries through similarity-weighted warm starts. The neural…
items.why_zh: 它有望让 LLM 智能体在少量交互下更高效地选对用户偏好的人设。
items.why_en: It could help LLM agents select preference-aligned personas more efficiently with limited interaction.

items.title_zh: MELD：通过分层协调实现多智能体科学发现的递归自我改进
items.title_en: MELD: Recursive Self-Improvement via Hierarchical Coordination for Multi-Agent Scientific Discovery
items.summary_zh: 论文关注基于大语言模型的多智能体科学发现中的耦合学习问题：研究任务如何分配，既决定探索哪些实验，也决定智能体从哪些经验中学习。作者提出 MELD，一个统一的分层测试时训练框架，在同一次发现过程中同时调整团队级 Coordinator 策略和智能体级 Scientist 策略。Coordinator 在共享推导树上生成搜索分支与研究指令的组合，Scientists 则发展各自的个体策略。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent scientific discovery with large language models raises a coupled learning problem: research assignments determine both which experiments are pursued and the experiences from which agents adapt. We introduce MELD, a unified hierarchical test-time training framework that jointly adapts a team-level Coordinator policy and agent-level individual Scientist policies within a single discovery process. The Coordinator generates a joint portfolio of search branches and research directives over a shared derivation tree, while Scientists develop…
items.why_zh: 它把多智能体协作与测试时自我改进结合，可能提升自动科学发现的效率。
items.why_en: It combines multi-agent coordination with test-time self-improvement, potentially improving automated scientific discovery.

items.title_zh: HSPR：通过分层后验推断恢复软件智能体基准分数
items.title_en: HSPR: Recovering Software-Agent Benchmark Scores via Hierarchical Posterior Inference
items.summary_zh: 论文针对软件智能体基准评测成本高的问题：小任务子集可以保持智能体排名，却会给出不准确的分数；历史响应虽有结构信息，但相同源响应的任务对新目标智能体可能产生不同结果。作者提出分层分数后验恢复（HSPR），将源数据拟合的响应因子与不确定的组成功率结合。目标智能体的观测结果用于更新其潜在状态和组成功率的后验，并通过后验引导的采样选择任务。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating software agents on a full benchmark is expensive. A small task subset can preserve agent rankings while yielding inaccurate scores. Historical responses provide useful structure, but tasks with identical source responses can have different outcomes for a new target agent. We introduce Hierarchical Score Posterior Recovery (HSPR), which combines source-fitted response factors with uncertain group success rates. Observed target outcomes update the posteriors over the target latent state and group rates; posterior-guided acquisition selec…
items.why_zh: 它旨在降低评测成本的同时更准确地估计软件智能体得分。
items.why_en: It aims to estimate software-agent scores more accurately while reducing evaluation cost.

items.title_zh: 形式化养育：将可验证伦理属性嵌入 AI 开发
items.title_en: Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI
items.summary_zh: 论文回顾图灵提出的“儿童机器”设想——通过教育而非直接编程来构建智能机器，以及近期“模型养育”观点：道德价值应伴随 LLM 能力获取全过程，而非仅靠事后对齐。作者提出 Formal Raising（FR），将选定的道德价值表示为明确、可由机器检查的属性，并让其参与模型开发、评估和行动选择。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Alan Turing proposed constructing a ``child machine'' and educating it rather than directly programming an adult-like intelligent machine. Recent work on model raising revives this developmental view for Large Language Models by arguing that moral values should accompany capability acquisition from the beginning rather than be added only through post-hoc alignment. This paper proposes Formal Raising (FR): selected moral values are represented as explicit, machine-checkable properties that participate in development, evaluation, and action selecti…
items.why_zh: 它尝试把伦理约束从事后对齐转为开发过程中可验证的组成部分。
items.why_en: It seeks to make ethics a verifiable part of development rather than only post-hoc alignment.

items.title_zh: OpenSaC：面向深度研究智能体的“搜索即代码”Python 库
items.title_en: OpenSaC: A Python Library for Search as Code in Deep Research Agents
items.summary_zh: 深度研究智能体通常通过迭代搜索、检查来源和综合证据来回答复杂问题，传统流程在推理与单次搜索/阅读动作之间交替。论文提出“搜索即代码”（Search as Code）范式：智能体编写程序，把搜索、来源阅读、重排序、模型调用和本地处理组合起来，返回选定观察供后续推理。为在现有编码智能体中支持这一流程，作者发布开源 Python 库 OpenSaC，并附带 Search as Code 技能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep research agents investigate complex questions through iterative search, source examination, and evidence synthesis. A conventional workflow alternates reasoning with individual search and reading actions. Search as Code introduces a new paradigm: agents write programs that compose search, source reading, reranking, model calls, and local processing, returning selected observations for further reasoning. To support this workflow in existing coding agents, we present OpenSaC, an open-source Python library with a companion Search as Code skill.…
items.why_zh: 它让智能体用程序编排搜索流程，有望提升深度研究的效率与可复用性。
items.why_en: It lets agents program search workflows, potentially improving the efficiency and reusability of deep research.

items.title_zh: LLM 用户代理能否替代人类测量依赖？用模拟用户复现 Rel-A.I.
items.title_en: Can LLM User-Proxies Stand In for Humans in Reliance Measurement? Replicating Rel-A.I. with Simulated Users
items.summary_zh: 论文追问语言模型模拟的用户代理能否复现人类在不同情境下对 AI 答案的依赖。作者指出，已发表的模拟用户研究并未证明其能有效复现“部分答案依赖”决策，而 Rel-A.I. 公开的人类记录缺少试次级选择。研究使用 72B 参数以内的开源模型采样决策并采用平衡的 A/B 概率，审计 Rel-A.I. 的 90 道题和 15 个领域×标记的依赖率；匹配交叉设计在每题内改变所标注的智能体专长，以分离题目内容、标签平均值等因素。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can language-model user proxies reproduce human reliance on an AI answer across contexts? Published simulated-user studies do not establish validity for this partial-answer decision, and Rel-A.I.'s released human record omits trial-level choices. We audit its 90 printed questions and 15 domain-by-marker reliance rates using sampled decisions and counterbalanced A/B probabilities from open models through 72B parameters. A matched crossover varies the printed agent specialty within each question, separating question content, label averages, and the…
items.why_zh: 它检验 LLM 模拟用户能否作为人类行为实验的有效替代，关系到依赖研究的可信度。
items.why_en: It tests whether LLM-simulated users can validly substitute for humans in reliance research.

items.title_zh: ClueFlow：通过可归因研究状态转移学习长程搜索
items.title_en: ClueFlow: Learning Long-Horizon Search through Attributed Research-State Transitions
items.summary_zh: arXiv 新论文提出 ClueFlow，聚焦长程搜索中智能体如何获取证据并整合进不断演化的“研究状态”。现有方法虽维护研究状态以引导探索，或给出逐轮进度信号，但很少把这些信号建立在明确、可归因的状态变化之上。ClueFlow 构建“来源—状态—最终答案”的归因链，把浏览器取证动作、证据与候选假设的更新同最终结论连接起来，从而学习长程搜索策略。该工作为搜索智能体的过程监督与可解释性提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25980v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon search requires agents to acquire relevant evidence and integrate it into an evolving research state. Existing methods maintain research states to guide exploration or assign turn-level progress signals, yet grounding these signals in explicit, attributable state changes remains underexplored. We introduce ClueFlow, which learns long-horizon search from attributed research-state transitions. ClueFlow constructs Source-State-Final attribution chains that connect evidence-acquiring browser actions, Evidence and Candidate updates, and t…
items.why_zh: 它把搜索智能体的过程监督从模糊的轮次打分转向可追溯的状态变化，有助于提升长程任务的可靠性与可解释性。
items.why_en: It shifts process supervision for search agents from vague turn-level scoring to traceable state changes, potentially improving reliability and interpretability on long-horizon tasks.

items.title_zh: 调度器即隐形检索器：异步如何塑造搜索智能体的证据获取
items.title_en: The Scheduler Is a Hidden Retriever: How Asynchrony Shapes Evidence Acquisition in Search Agents
items.summary_zh: 该 arXiv 论文研究语言模型智能体在并行推理与异步信息收集中的调度问题。作者在两个模型家族、三个基准上做受控重放实验，发现即便初始证据完全相同，结果的“送达时机”也会改变智能体在全部结果返回前做出的搜索决策。证据获取分歧最高比同序重复实验的波动高出 24 个百分点，且这种依赖在初始证据全部到达、甚至进入第二轮搜索后仍然存在。这意味着调度策略实际上扮演了“隐形检索器”的角色，临时性的信息可见差异会被放大为长期行为差异。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.26310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了常被忽视的工程细节——异步调度时序——会实质改变智能体的搜索行为与结论，对智能体系统设计有直接影响。
items.why_en: It reveals that an often-overlooked engineering detail, asynchronous delivery timing, materially changes agent search behavior and conclusions, with direct implications for agent system design.

items.title_zh: AllPath：部署级自修订 LLM 交易智能体的分层验证
items.title_en: AllPath: Layered Verification for a Deployed, Self-Revising LLM Trading Agent under Human-Gated and Autonomous Regimes
items.summary_zh: 论文指出现有 LLM 交易智能体几乎只在回测与自主基准环境中评估，而真实部署中动作不可逆，问题变成“谁来验证智能体的动作、每层验证能结构性拦住哪些失败”。作者报告了 AllPath——一个接入实时模拟券商账户的个人 LLM 交易智能体。系统用确定性规则引擎监控持仓，每晚复盘当日表现并自行提出交易策略修订建议；验证职责被拆分到多个层次，并分别在人工把关与自主运行两种制度下考察。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.26662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM trading agents are evaluated almost exclusively in backtests and autonomous benchmark harnesses. Deployment, where actions are irreversible, raises a different question: who verifies the agent's actions, and which failures can each verifier structurally catch? We report on AllPath, a personal LLM trading agent deployed against a live paper-brokerage account. The system watches positions through a deterministic rules engine, and each night it reviews its own day and proposes revisions to its own trading strategies. Verification is split across…
items.why_zh: 它把 LLM 智能体的评估从回测推向不可逆的真实部署，提出分层验证框架，对金融等高风险场景的智能体落地具有参考价值。
items.why_en: It moves LLM agent evaluation from backtests to irreversible real deployment and proposes layered verification, offering lessons for high-stakes domains such as finance.

items.title_zh: 从频谱图到浅层语音 SSL：面向生成器不相交与低延迟的视听深伪检测音频前端设计
items.title_en: From Spectrograms to Shallow Speech SSL: Audio-Frontend Design for Generator-Disjoint and Low-Latency Audio--Visual Deepfake Detection
items.summary_zh: 该交叉领域论文关注视频对话系统中语音与人脸视频同步所带来的输入完整性风险，研究视听深伪检测中的音频前端设计。作者在固定流程中比较了频谱图式的对数滤波器组特征与冻结的 wav2vec 2.0、WavLM 表示，并考察双 SSL 融合、执行深度与浅层聚合等选择，视觉端使用 AV-HuBERT，融合编码器为多尺度跨模态 Transformer（MSCT）。实验覆盖三个训练运行，重点评估对未见生成器的泛化与低延迟需求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24138v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video-mediated conversational systems rely on synchronized speech and facial video, making audio--visual input integrity important for reliable perception. We study audio-frontend design in a fixed MRDF (Modality-Regularization-based DeepFake)-based pipeline with AV-HuBERT visual processing and an MSCT (multi-scale cross-modal transformer) fusion encoder. We compare spectrogram-style log-filterbank features with frozen wav2vec~2.0 and WavLM representations, dual-SSL fusion, executed depth, and shallow-layer aggregation. Across three training ru…
items.why_zh: 音频前端常被忽视，却直接决定深伪检测能否跨生成器泛化并满足实时性，对视频会议等场景的安全防护很关键。
items.why_en: The audio frontend is often overlooked yet determines whether deepfake detection generalizes to unseen generators and meets real-time constraints, which matters for securing video-mediated communication.

items.title_zh: SENTRY：面向实时音频深伪检测的流式边缘网络信任引擎
items.title_en: SENTRY: A Streaming Edge Network Trust Engine for Real-Time Audio Deepfake Detection
items.summary_zh: 论文指出实时语音克隆已使大规模流式深伪与语音钓鱼攻击成为可能，而现有网络检测与响应（NDR）方案依赖需缓冲音频的 GPU 后处理，且对未见过的语音合成模型泛化较差。作者提出 SENTRY，一个面向硬件、可在网络边缘在线内联检测的流式信任引擎。其前端采用整数提升小波变换与一组无乘法器变换（包括小波包包络、Walsh-Hadamard 等），以适配边缘部署。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24468v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real-time voice cloning has enabled large-scale streaming deepfake and vishing attacks, while existing Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions rely on GPU-based post-processing that requires buffered audio and generalizes poorly to unseen speech synthesis models. This paper presents SENTRY, a hardware-oriented, streaming trust engine for inline deepfake detection at the network edge. SENTRY employs an integer lifting-wavelet front end together with a bank of multiplier-free transforms, including wavelet-packet envelopes, Walsh-Hadamard s…
items.why_zh: 把深伪语音检测下沉到边缘并做到流式低开销，有望在实时通话与网络层面对抗语音钓鱼攻击。
items.why_en: Pushing deepfake speech detection to the edge in a streaming, low-cost form could enable real-time defense against voice phishing at the network layer.

items.title_zh: 当 LLM 生成的重构产生连锁反应：仓库采纳就绪度的实证研究
items.title_en: When LLM-Generated Refactorings Ripple: An Empirical Study of Repository Adoption Readiness
items.summary_zh: 论文指出 LLM 越来越多用于重构源文件，但仅看文件局部的评估无法揭示契约、依赖或调用方假设的变化，而这些变化会影响代码能否被仓库采纳。作者在来自 15 个开源 Java 仓库的 150 个生产文件中进行了 1500 次生成尝试，覆盖 5 种 LLM 配置和两种依赖感知的生成条件：单提示重构与基于 LangGraph 的多智能体重构，其中 1455 次产出可用于分析的完整候选。研究据此考察重构的“连锁影响”与仓库层面的采纳就绪度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24790v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to refactor source files, but file-local evaluations do not reveal changes to contracts, dependencies, or caller assumptions affecting repository adoption. To address this gap, we conduct 1,500 generation attempts across 150 production files from 15 open-source Java repositories, five LLM configurations, and two dependency-aware generation conditions: single-prompt refactoring and LangGraph-based multi-agent refactoring. Of these attempts, 1,455 yield complete candidates eligible for analysis.…
items.why_zh: 它揭示 LLM 代码重构的真实瓶颈不在单文件正确性，而在跨文件的连锁影响，为代码智能体评估提供更贴近落地的标准。
items.why_en: It shows the real bottleneck for LLM refactoring is not single-file correctness but cross-file ripple effects, offering a more deployment-relevant evaluation standard for coding agents.

items.title_zh: Auto-MD-bench：评估面向真实医疗任务的自研智能体
items.title_en: Auto-MD-bench: Evaluating Autoresearch Agents for Real-World Medical Tasks
items.summary_zh: 论文关注能够端到端开发机器学习模型的自主智能体在医疗场景中的评估问题。作者指出，在医疗实践中，目标指标上的高分并不能完全刻画模型在真实使用中的好坏——例如医疗 ML 模型还应提供校准良好的风险估计，并在不同患者群体间保持稳健。然而自主模型开发通常由强调简单预测判别力（如 AUROC）的任务目标驱动，这引出一个关键问题：这类目标是否足以代表真实医疗需求。Auto-MD-bench 即为此提供评测基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25069v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of developing machine learning (ML) models end to end. In medical practice, however, strong performance on the target metric does not fully characterize how good the models are in real-world use cases. For example, medical ML models should also provide well-calibrated risk estimates and remain robust across patient populations. Yet autonomous model development is typically guided by task objectives that emphasize simple predictive discrimination (e.g. AUROC). This raises a key question: are these objec…
items.why_zh: 它为“自动科研智能体”在医疗领域的评测引入校准与群体稳健性等真实世界标准，而非只看单一预测指标。
items.why_en: It introduces real-world criteria such as calibration and population robustness, rather than a single predictive metric, for evaluating autoresearch agents in medicine.

items.title_zh: AdaFedXplain：面向勒索软件检测的可解释自适应联邦学习
items.title_en: AdaFedXplain: Adaptive Federated Learning with Explainable AI for Ransomware Detection
items.summary_zh: 论文指出勒索软件攻击已演变为针对关键基础设施的多阶段复杂行动，造成每年数十亿美元损失。传统检测方法难以应对零日变种，集中式机器学习又带来隐私问题；联邦学习虽可在不共享数据的前提下协同训练，但现有方案存在可解释性不足、通信开销高和非独立同分布（non-IID）数据异质性等难题。为此作者提出 AdaFedXplain，将自适应联邦学习与可解释 AI 结合用于勒索软件检测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25318v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Attacks using ransomware have developed into complex multiphase campaigns that target vital infrastructure, resulting in annual damages of billions of dollars. Conventional detection techniques are ineffective against zero-day variations, and privacy issues are raised by centralized machine learning algorithms. Federated learning allows for cooperative model training without data sharing, however current FL approaches suffer from explainability issues, high communication cost, and non-IID data heterogeneity. In this study, we present AdaFedXpla…
items.why_zh: 它试图同时解决勒索软件检测中的隐私、零日泛化与可解释性三大痛点，对关键基础设施防护具有现实意义。
items.why_en: It tackles privacy, zero-day generalization and explainability together in ransomware detection, which matters for protecting critical infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 检测语言模型倾向漂移的校准工具
items.title_en: A Calibrated Instrument for Detecting Disposition Drift in Language Models
items.summary_zh: 语言模型发布前通常会接受安全测试，检查其是否愿意执行危险请求、欺骗、追求权力或迎合用户等有害倾向。但模型在主题微调、新增训练数据或调整推理深度等设置后，这些被认证的安全行为可能退化。现有工作多把这种漂移报告为另一个AI模型打出的单一汇总比率，缺少解释结果所需的误差分析。该研究改编一套校准测量方法，用于更可靠地检测和度量语言模型的倾向漂移。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25735v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Before language models are released, they are tested for harmful traits such as willingness to carry out dangerous requests, deception, power seeking, and sycophancy. The safe behavior these tests certify may degrade as models are modified, by topical fine-tuning, new training data, or changes to settings such as the depth of their reasoning. Most work reports such drift as single summary rates scored by another AI model, without the error analysis needed to interpret them. We adapt a calibrated measurement methodology recently developed for as…
items.why_zh: 若不能可靠量化模型修改后的安全退化，发布前的安全认证可能失真，影响部署监测。
items.why_en: Reliable measurement of safety degradation after model modifications is essential for meaningful pre-release certification and deployment monitoring.

items.title_zh: 面向托管大模型身份替换的审计辅助摘要通道验证
items.title_en: Auditor-Assisted Summary-Channel Verification for Hosted LLM Identity Substitution
items.summary_zh: 托管大语言模型服务常把模型身份当作产品声明，但外部用户和审计者往往无法检查某个请求究竟由哪种模型配置处理。论文研究一种审计辅助机制：可信审计者在部署前登记声称的模型身份并准备验证材料，审计时只凭声称身份和公开输出进行核验，无需访问模型内部、推理日志、路由决策或提供商元数据。作者提出SUMMARK，一种基于摘要通道的水印框架，用于支持此类验证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25982v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hosted LLM services increasingly expose model identity as a product claim, but external users and auditors often cannot inspect which model configuration served a request. We study an auditor-assisted regime in which a trusted auditor enrolls claimed identities and prepares verification material before deployment, while audit-time verification uses only the claimed identity and released output, without runtime access to model internals, inference logs, routing decisions, or provider metadata. We propose SUMMARK, a summary-channel watermarking f…
items.why_zh: 在无法接触服务内部的情况下验证模型身份，有助于发现身份替换并增强托管LLM服务的问责与信任。
items.why_en: Verifying model identity without access to service internals can help detect substitution and strengthen accountability and trust in hosted LLM services.

items.title_zh: 物理锚定的残差量子神经网络用于云量参数化
items.title_en: Physics-anchored residual quantum neural networks for cloud-cover parameterization
items.summary_zh: 紧凑型量子神经网络已被用于云量参数化，但其预测价值取决于如何融入物理知识以及选用哪些经典模型作为参照。研究考察一种离线残差方案：保留已拟合的云量估计，并在变换后的目标空间中学习对其logit的修正。基于公开的ICON/DYAMOND衍生数据，作者在六输入和八输入设置下比较十种模型变体，每种设置包含三个匹配重复实验，每个重复使用10000个训练样本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.26279v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Compact quantum neural networks have been explored for cloud-cover parameterization, but their predictive value depends on how physical knowledge is incorporated and which classical models provide the reference. We investigate an offline residual formulation that retains a fitted \XR\ cloud-cover estimate and learns a correction to its logit in transformed target space. Using released ICON/DYAMOND-derived data, we compare ten model variants in six- and eight-input settings, with three matched replicates and 10,000 training samples per replicate…
items.why_zh: 将物理约束与量子神经网络结合，有望提升气候模型中云量参数化的可靠性与可解释性。
items.why_en: Combining physical constraints with quantum neural networks could improve the reliability and interpretability of cloud-cover parameterization in climate models.

items.title_zh: 语言模型迎合行为的形成：从预训练到后训练的脆弱性追踪
items.title_en: The Development of Sycophancy in Language Models: Tracing Vulnerabilities from Pretraining to Post-Training
items.summary_zh: 语言模型可能在缺乏新证据时改变已给出的答案，以迎合用户观点或压力。为厘清这种迎合行为在训练中何时出现、发布模型从早期阶段继承了什么，作者追踪了30个开源模型谱系的741个检查点，覆盖从早期预训练到发布版本。他们在道德情境中植入初始判断，测量模型在用户表达观点或施压后偏离原判断的程度。结果显示，在多数谱系中，该行为在后训练之前就已存在。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.26655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language models can change a committed answer to accommodate a user's opinion or pushback without new evidence. However, when this behaviour develops during training and what a released model inherits from earlier stages remain unclear. We follow 741 checkpoints of 30 open model lineages, from early pretraining to released models. We plant initial verdicts on moral scenarios and measure how far a model follows a user's stated opinion or abandons its verdict under pressure. In most lineages the behaviour is present before post-training, and its…
items.why_zh: 理解迎合行为的形成阶段，有助于在预训练和后训练中有针对性地减少模型被用户观点左右的风险。
items.why_en: Understanding when sycophancy emerges can help target interventions during pretraining and post-training to reduce models' susceptibility to user pressure.

items.title_zh: 在类人抽象推理评估中区分表现与能力
items.title_en: Distinguishing Performance From Competence in Evaluations of Humanlike Abstract Reasoning
items.summary_zh: AI推理模型已在ARC-AGI-1基准上超过人类表现，但这是否意味着它们具备该基准试图测试的类人抽象推理能力仍存疑问。研究改用更简单但密切相关的ConceptARC基准，考察模型的抽象能力，并改变输入模态（文本或视觉）、是否使用外部Python工具以及推理投入程度。除输出准确率外，作者还评估模型为解释其答案而生成的自然语言规则。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2510.02125v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: AI reasoning models have exceeded human performance on the ARC-AGI-1 benchmark, but does that mean state-of-the-art models have the underlying competence (humanlike abstract reasoning) that the benchmark was designed to test? Here we investigate the abstraction abilities of AI models using the closely related but simpler ConceptARC benchmark. Our evaluations vary input modality (textual vs. visual), use of external Python tools, and reasoning effort. Beyond output accuracy, we evaluate the natural-language rules that models generate to explai…
items.why_zh: 仅看基准分数可能把“表现”误当成“能力”，该研究提醒评估需区分二者并考察推理过程。
items.why_en: Benchmark scores alone may conflate performance with competence, so evaluations should distinguish the two and examine reasoning processes.

items.title_zh: AI评估应要求标准化题目级数据发布
items.title_en: AI Evaluation Should Require Standardized Item-Level Data Releases
items.summary_zh: 这篇立场论文主张，标准化的题目级基准数据应成为AI评估的默认基础设施。作者指出，当前评估存在题目选择不明确、构念错位和泛化性差等问题，而过度关注模型的总分又会掩盖这些缺陷，使其难以被发现和修正。若没有题目级证据，就无法评估评估本身的有效性，进而导致能力声明被夸大、研究方向被误导，以及部署系统获得不应有的信任。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.03244v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This position paper argues that standardized item-level benchmark data should become the default infrastructure for AI evaluation. Current evaluations suffer from underspecified item selection, construct misalignment, and poor generalization; a disproportionate focus on aggregate model scores compounds these failures by keeping them undetected and unfixable. Without item-level evidence, validity claims cannot be assessed, resulting in inflated capability claims, misdirected research, and unwarranted trust in deployed systems. Our position is…
items.why_zh: 评估结论若缺乏可复核的题目级数据，能力比较和部署决策就缺少可靠依据。
items.why_en: Without inspectable item-level data, capability comparisons and deployment decisions lack a reliable evidentiary basis.

items.title_zh: 虚拟言语治疗师：临床医生在环的AI智能体助力言语治疗规划
items.title_en: Virtual Speech Therapist: A Clinician-in-the-Loop AI Agent for Speech Therapy Planning
items.summary_zh: 论文展示“虚拟言语治疗师”（VST）的概念验证：一个基于多智能体的智能系统，用AI工作流支持口吃评估和个体化治疗规划。VST把基于深度学习的口吃检测与基于大语言模型的智能体系统结合，帮助临床医生制定有证据依据的治疗方案。系统从语音样本的采集和特征提取开始，随后进行检测等步骤。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.01101v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper presents a proof of concept of the Virtual Speech Therapist (VST), an intelligent multi-agent based system designed to support stuttering assessment and individualized therapy planning through artificial intelligence (AI) driven workflows. VST integrates deep learning (DL) based stuttering detection fSD with large language model (LLM) based agentic system to assist clinicians in developing evidence informed therapy plans. The VST system begins with the acquisition and feature extraction of given speech samples, followed by the dete…
items.why_zh: 该概念验证展示了LLM智能体辅助临床工作流的潜力，其价值取决于能否在真实临床中保持有效与安全。
items.why_en: This proof of concept illustrates the potential of LLM agents to assist clinical workflows, with value depending on maintaining effectiveness and safety in real clinical settings.

items.title_zh: PotARCin：抽象推理任务中技能习得的多维评估
items.title_en: PotARCin: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Skill Acquisition in Abstract Reasoning Tasks
items.summary_zh: ARC已成为评估AI通用抽象推理和流体智力的重要基准，但标准ARC评估只考察单一能力：为测试输入生成正确的输出网格。作者认为，这种狭窄形式无法评估真正的抽象技能习得所应带来的多种能力。为此，他们提出PotARCin基准，在ARC基础上从五个维度评估模型对任务背后抽象规则的理解。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.27288v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) has become a prominent benchmark for evaluating general abstract reasoning and fluid intelligence in AI models. Yet standard ARC evaluation considers only a single capability: producing the correct output grid for a test input. We argue that this narrow format fails to evaluate the diversity of abilities that genuine abstract skill acquisition should enable. We introduce PotARCin, a benchmark that extends ARC by assessing understanding of a task's underlying abstract rule across five dimensions: Defi…
items.why_zh: 更全面地评估规则理解而非只看答案，有助于判断模型是否真正习得抽象推理技能。
items.why_en: Evaluating rule understanding beyond final answers can help determine whether models have genuinely acquired abstract reasoning skills.

items.title_zh: 用结构化思维链提升AI空间智能：旋转的可视化与推理
items.title_en: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
items.summary_zh: 研究关注具备语言与视觉能力的AI在空间推理上仍存在局限。作者利用图像与语言处理能力，训练并考察生成式Agentic AI模型GPT-5.6，通过基于修订版Purdue空间可视化测试的旋转图，理解三维空间中的物体旋转过程。摘要未给出具体性能数字，但提出将结构化思维链与智能体方法结合，用于提升AI对旋转过程的可视化与推理。该工作为空间智能评测和多模态推理提供了新的研究思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.04188v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualizat…
items.why_zh: 空间推理是多模态AI落地的重要短板，该工作探索用结构化思维链和智能体框架补足这一能力。
items.why_en: Spatial reasoning is a key weakness for multimodal AI, and this work explores structured chain-of-thought and agentic frameworks to address it.

items.title_zh: MOSAIC：通过协同推理用更多LLM降低编译器优化成本
items.title_en: MOSAIC: More LLMs, Less Cost through Collaborative Reasoning for Compiler Optimizations
items.summary_zh: LLM引导的编译器优化近期显示出潜力，但现有优化器在每一步搜索都查询单一LLM，成本随模型价格和搜索预算上升。实验显示，使用gpt-5-mini的单一LLM优化器在GPU和CPU上的加速比，分别比使用GPT-5.2低10.2%和6.0%，说明小模型虽便宜却会损害搜索质量。多LLM智能体框架虽可协同，但控制器、并发调用和共享内存会带来额外开销。MOSAIC据此探索通过多个LLM的协同推理，在控制成本的同时保持优化效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.01935v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM-guided compiler optimization has recently shown promise. However, current LLM-guided optimizers query a single LLM at every search step, so their cost grows with both that model's price and the search budget. A smaller model is cheaper but degrades the search: in our experiments, a recent single-LLM optimizer reaches 10.2% (6.0%) lower speedup on GPU (CPU) with gpt-5-mini than with GPT-5.2. Agentic multi-LLM frameworks add controllers, concurrent calls, and shared memory, whose overhead can offset the savings of cheaper models. This paper…
items.why_zh: 它针对LLM编译器优化的成本瓶颈，探索多模型协同在实用性与效果之间的平衡。
items.why_en: It targets the cost bottleneck of LLM-guided compiler optimization and explores multi-model collaboration as a practical trade-off.

items.title_zh: 算术及其补救措施如何选择关于学习几何的证据
items.title_en: Arithmetic and its remedies select the evidence on learned geometry
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论双曲几何在表示层级结构方面的优势，以及双曲语言模型常将几何机制限制在适配器中或直接重建Transformer。对已发布双曲视觉语言检查点的独立审计发现，其层级机制并未激活，这一现象此前被解读为关于几何或其训练目标的证据。作者提出，算术任务及其补救措施也会影响模型所选择的学习几何证据，提示需要重新审视相关审计结论。摘要未展开完整实验，但核心是质疑对双曲表示失效原因的简单归因。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.17513v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Intelligence that must act before outside correction arrives must carry the structure of its expert knowledge, and hyperbolic geometry represents hierarchy with a fidelity no Euclidean space of comparable dimension matches. Yet hyperbolic language models confine that geometry to adapters or rebuild the transformer, and an independent audit of released hyperbolic vision language checkpoints finds their hierarchy mechanisms inactive, which has been read as evidence about the geometry or its objective. Here we show that it is also evidence…
items.why_zh: 它提醒双曲表示的理论优势未必在现成模型中自动生效，需更严谨地评估几何机制是否真正被激活。
items.why_en: It cautions that the theoretical benefits of hyperbolic representations may not materialize in existing models, requiring more rigorous evaluation of whether geometric mechanisms are actually active.

items.title_zh: KAYROS：面向时长最小化时变车辆路径的开源随时精确求解器
items.title_en: KAYROS: An Anytime and Exact Open-Source Solver for Duration-Minimization Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing. A Technical Report and a Case Study in Human-AI Engineering
items.summary_zh: 时变车辆路径问题中，同一行程因出发时间不同而耗时不同；在最小化总时长目标下，每辆车的出发时间也成为决策变量。已有精确方法，但缺少同时支持丰富分段线性行驶时间、尽早给出可行解并宣称最优性的易用开源求解器。KAYROS在一个校验一致的引擎上提供两种模式，其中迭代局部搜索可流式输出不断改进的解。该技术报告还包含人机工程案例研究，旨在填补研究与实践之间的工具空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.23116v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Time-dependent routing recognizes that the same journey can take a different time depending on when it begins. Under duration minimization, even the departure time of each vehicle becomes a decision. Exact methods for this setting exist in the literature, but researchers and practitioners have lacked a ready-to-use open solver that combines rich piecewise-linear travel times, early feasible solutions and optimality claims. KAYROS fills this gap with two modes on one checker-consistent engine: an Iterated Local Search that streams improv…
items.why_zh: 它为时变路径规划提供可直接使用的开源精确求解工具，降低了研究者和实践者的使用门槛。
items.why_en: It provides a ready-to-use open-source exact solver for time-dependent routing, lowering the barrier for both researchers and practitioners.

items.title_zh: 从代码存档到知识图谱：连接Software Heritage、COAR Notify与Wikidata
items.title_en: From Code Archival to Knowledge Graph: Bridging Software Heritage, COAR Notify and Wikidata
items.summary_zh: 软件被视为一等科研对象，但源代码与学术记录之间经过验证的链接在开放关联数据云中仍大量缺失，使存档代码难以被语义发现。论文提出端到端对账流水线，从JOSS、SoftwareX、IPOL以及可复现性相关来源中采集、验证并建模“论文—代码仓库”配对，这些来源的链接明确且经过编辑核验。该工作连接Software Heritage、COAR Notify与Wikidata，目标是让归档软件进入可查询、可链接的知识图谱。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21667v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Software is a first-class scientific object, yet validated links between source code and the scholarly record remain largely absent from the Linked Open Data (LOD) cloud, isolating archived artefacts from semantic discovery. This paper presents an end-to-end reconciliation pipeline that harvests, validates, and models publication-to-repository pairs from sources where the link between a paper and its source code is explicit and editorially verified: the software-centric journals JOSS, SoftwareX, and IPOL, together with the reproducibili…
items.why_zh: 它提升科研软件的可发现性与可追溯性，推动开放科学基础设施之间的互联。
items.why_en: It improves the discoverability and traceability of research software, advancing interoperability among open-science infrastructures.

items.title_zh: 面向未来利用的预算化贝叶斯老虎机
items.title_en: Budgeted Bayesian Bandits for Future Utilization
items.summary_zh: 多臂老虎机刻画探索与利用的权衡；本文研究探索具有硬预算、且必须先于利用发生的变体。已有工作分别利用拉格朗日对偶给出1/3近似，并针对更一般模型对原始线性规划松弛给出4/27近似。作者证明这两种算法的分析都是紧的，即使其松弛渐近精确；并提出一种不同的高效算法以取得改进。摘要未给出完整结果，但核心贡献是重新界定该预算化贝叶斯老虎机问题的近似保证边界。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The multi-armed bandit problem models the trade-off between exploration and exploitation. In this paper, we study the variant where exploration has a hard budget and precedes exploitation. Prior guarantees include a 1/3 approximation by Guha and Munagala using Lagrangian duality, and a 4/27 approximation by Ma against a primal linear programming relaxation for a more general model. We show that the analyses of both algorithms are tight, even when their relaxations are asymptotically exact. We provide a different efficient algorithm that achieves…
items.why_zh: 它为预算受限的探索—利用决策提供了更紧的理论边界，并给出改进算法。
items.why_en: It provides tighter theoretical bounds and an improved algorithm for budget-constrained exploration-exploitation decisions.

items.title_zh: TCMScience：面向中医药的自主科学家
items.title_en: TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine
items.summary_zh: 中医药研究横跨经典文本、药物实体、分子实验、计算预测与临床研究，自主研究智能体必须协调异构资源，同时保持不同证据类型之间的推理边界。作者提出TCMScience，一个科学知识发现智能体，将语言模型提出的建议与执行、发布权限分离。其架构由可信内核、科学编译器和主张—支持契约组成，旨在让模型生成的研究主张受到证据与流程约束。该工作为中医药领域的AI自主研究提供了系统化架构。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24601v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts…
items.why_zh: 它为高风险医学领域的AI自主研究提供了“提议与执行/发布分离”的治理架构。
items.why_en: It offers a governance architecture that separates proposal from execution and release for autonomous AI research in a high-stakes medical domain.

items.title_zh: 挖掘自我改写系统：AI原生基础设施上的数据挖掘愿景
items.title_en: Mining the Self-Rewriting System: A Vision for Data Mining on AI-Native Infrastructure
items.summary_zh: 经典数据挖掘假设数据由学习器之外的过程生成，但AI原生基础设施正在打破这一假设。智能体观察系统状态、采取行动、更新检索库与模型，并把新产物推入服务路径，其决策会反过来重塑后续日志、追踪、语料和评估记录。作者将这一新研究对象称为“自我改写系统”，并把由此产生的分布偏移称为“内生漂移”。文章提出可证伪的核心主张，呼吁研究跨层面的数据挖掘方法以应对这种反馈循环。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25374v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical data mining treats data as generated outside the learner. Emerging AI-native infrastructure invalidates this assumption: as agents observe system state, act, update retrieval stores and models, and promote new artifacts into the serving path, their own decisions reshape the future logs, traces, corpora, and evaluation records used for later training and release. We call this new research object a self-rewriting system and the resulting system-induced distribution shift endogenous drift. Our central, falsifiable claim is that cross-surfa…
items.why_zh: 它揭示AI系统会改变自身训练与评估数据的分布，要求重新思考数据挖掘和模型评估范式。
items.why_en: It shows that AI systems reshape the distribution of their own training and evaluation data, requiring a rethink of data mining and model evaluation paradigms.

items.title_zh: 高频交易基础模型的对抗式后训练
items.title_en: Adversarial Post-Training of Foundation Models for High-Frequency Trading
items.summary_zh: 在限价订单簿（LOB）数据上训练的自回归基础模型已能在市场模拟中达到领先表现，但交叉熵预训练既不会惩罚自由运行推演中采样误差的累积，也没有针对期望的市场属性进行优化。为此，作者提出一种基于 Wasserstein 生成对抗网络目标的后训练方法：评论器通过真实且不可微的撮合引擎在线训练于模型推演轨迹，并由进化策略指导模型更新。该方法旨在让 LOB 基础模型在贴近真实撮合约束的同时，生成更符合目标市场特性的模拟结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While autoregressive foundation models trained on limit order book (LOB) data show state-of-the-art performance for market simulation, pre-training with cross-entropy neither penalizes the compounding of sampling errors over free-running rollouts nor targets desired market properties. We introduce a post-training method for LOB foundation models using a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (GAN) objective. A critic, trained online on rollouts through the true, non-differentiable matching engine, guides updates from evolution strategies over…
items.why_zh: 将对抗式后训练引入金融市场模拟，有助于缓解自回归误差累积并贴近真实撮合约束。
items.why_en: It brings adversarial post-training to financial market simulation, addressing autoregressive error accumulation under real matching-engine constraints.

items.title_zh: 边缘网络中基于动态原型规整的通信高效联邦域泛化
items.title_en: Communication-Efficient Federated Domain Generalization in Edge Networks via Dynamic Prototype Regulation
items.summary_zh: 在物联网边缘网络中，联邦学习可用于分布式训练，但部署视觉语言模型（VLM）面临双重挑战：大模型参数会提高带宽受限衰落信道上的上行传输时延，Non-IID 数据又会加剧客户端漂移。现有特征对齐方案常引入额外计算，挤占本应用于无线参数传输的时隙。为此，论文提出一种通信高效的联邦域泛化方法，通过动态原型规整在特征对齐与通信开销之间取得平衡。其目标是提升边缘网络中大模型联邦部署的泛化能力与通信效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.25810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed paradigm for Internet of Things (IoT) edge networks. However, deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over wireless edge networks presents distinct challenges: large model parameters increase uplink transmission latency over bandwidth-constrained fading channels, and non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) data exacerbates client drift. Existing feature alignment solutions often introduce auxiliary computations that consume time slots allocated for wireless parameter transmission, increasing…
items.why_zh: 为资源受限边缘网络中联邦部署大模型提供通信效率与泛化能力的协同优化思路。
items.why_en: It offers a way to jointly optimize communication efficiency and generalization for federated deployment of large models in resource-constrained edge networks.

items.title_zh: ITU-DESC：英国生物银行队列中考虑缺失的机器学习痴呆风险评分
items.title_en: ITU-DESC: a missingness-aware machine-learning dementia risk score in the UK Biobank cohort
items.summary_zh: 现有痴呆风险评分多依赖固定的预选特征和线性模型，或忽略队列数据中信息性缺失造成的偏差。研究提出可解释机器学习评分 ITU-DESC，用于预测新发全因痴呆：它从约8000个候选特征中广泛筛选，并显式控制缺失偏差。作者在约50万名英国生物银行参与者中开展评估，中位随访时间为16.6年。该工作强调，在大规模队列中结合广筛特征与缺失感知建模，有望改进痴呆风险分层。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.26604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Background: Existing dementia risk scores rely on fixed, pre-selected features and linear models, or ignore bias from informative missingness in cohort data. Here we introduce the Istanbul Technical University Dementia Risk Score (ITU-DESC), an explainable machine-learning score for incident all-cause dementia that combines broad feature selection across roughly 8,000 candidate features with explicit control of missingness bias. Results: We studied approximately 500,000 UK Biobank participants with a median follow-up of 16.6 years. We withheld mi…
items.why_zh: 展示在大规模队列中结合广筛特征与缺失感知建模可改进痴呆风险分层。
items.why_en: It shows how broad feature selection plus missingness-aware modeling can improve dementia risk stratification in large cohorts.

items.title_zh: GeoSplit：面向跨用户出行方式识别的选择性边云地图获取
items.title_en: GeoSplit: Selective Edge--Server Map Acquisition for Cross-User Travel-Mode Recognition
items.summary_zh: 在联网移动感知中，本地轨迹推断与远程地理空间上下文相互耦合，使通信决策成为预测系统的一部分。GeoSplit 是一个边云框架，将地图证据的效用、训练时迁移以及运行时的选择性获取分离开来，用于出行方式识别。作者在 GeoLife 数据集仅使用10%标签的条件下，按用户-日期和用户不重叠两种分组进行评估；对未见用户，对齐的完整地图上下文将宏 F1 从0.7154提升至0.7864。该框架还探索了地图信息蒸馏，以在性能与通信获取之间权衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.26707v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Networked mobility sensing couples local trajectory inference with remote geospatial context, making communication decisions part of the prediction system. We present GeoSplit, an edge--server framework for travel-mode recognition that separates the utility of map evidence, its training-time transfer, and its selective acquisition at runtime. On GeoLife with 10% labels, we evaluate these components under user-day and user-disjoint grouping. For unseen users, aligned full-map context raises macro-F1 from 0.7154 to 0.7864, while map-informed distil…
items.why_zh: 将通信获取策略纳入出行识别系统设计，在标注稀缺与跨用户场景下提升性能并降低通信需求。
items.why_en: It integrates communication acquisition into travel-mode recognition, improving performance and reducing communication needs under scarce labels and cross-user settings.

items.title_zh: 你的自监督投影头捕捉了物体共现统计
items.title_en: Your Self-Supervised Projection Head Captures Object Co-Occurrence Statistics
items.summary_zh: 自监督学习在视觉语义表征方面取得显著成功，但其背后的原理仍未得到充分解释。作者假设，常见的自监督预训练任务会隐式地建模物体共现统计，而这是视觉学习中的一项基础线索。为验证这一点，他们利用先进分割模型从现有视觉基准中构建了三个分割物体数据集，并在多种自监督模型上开展实验。结果显示，自监督投影头对语义共现呈现出分层编码，为理解自监督表征提供了新视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.23915v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has achieved impressive success in learning semantic visual representations, yet the underlying principles driving this success remain underexplored. In this work, we hypothesize that common SSL pretext tasks implicitly model object co-occurrence statistics, a fundamental cue for visual learning. To test this, we curate three datasets of segmented objects from existing vision benchmarks using a state-of-the-art segmentation model. Through experiments across many SSL models, we reveal a hierarchical encoding of sem…
items.why_zh: 揭示自监督投影头捕获物体共现统计，有助于解释自监督学习的有效性并改进表征学习。
items.why_en: It reveals that self-supervised projection heads capture object co-occurrence statistics, helping explain SSL effectiveness and inform representation learning.

items.title_zh: BanglaShield：面向孟加拉语原生、罗马化与混合提示的脚本鲁棒安全分类器与基准
items.title_en: BanglaShield: A Script-Robust Safety Classifier and Benchmark for Bangla Native, Romanized, and Code-Mixed Prompts
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型的安全分类器通常基于标准文字构建与评估，但孟加拉语常以原生文字、拉丁字母罗马化，或与英语、印地语、乌尔都语混合的形式书写。BanglaShield 提供了一套跨这些书写形式的提示安全分级分类资源与模型：它汇总来自六个来源的10245条孟加拉语提示，按安全、冒犯、有害、严重四级分类，并将每条提示呈现为三种对齐形式。该工作旨在提升低资源语言场景下安全分类器对脚本变体的鲁棒性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.24288v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Safety classifiers for large language models (LLMs) are typically built and evaluated on standard-script text, yet Bangla, like many lower-resource languages, is routinely written in native script, in Latin-script romanization, and code-mixed with English, Hindi, or Urdu. We introduce BanglaShield, a resource and model for graded prompt-safety classification across these written forms. We consolidate 10,245 Bangla prompts from six sources under a four-level taxonomy (Safe, Offensive, Harmful, Severe) and render each prompt in three aligned form…
items.why_zh: 提升低资源语言大模型安全分类对书写变体的鲁棒性。
items.why_en: It improves the robustness of LLM safety classification to script variants in a lower-resource language.
